stories.title: Putin Observes Naval Drills Before Controversial Visit to Disputed Kuril Islands
stories.summary: President Vladimir Putin observed naval exercises off Sakhalin Island before making a controversial visit to the Kuril Islands, which Japan claims. This visit has prompted strong protests from Japan, with officials labeling it 'unacceptable' and summoning the Russian ambassador to express their discontent. This marks the first visit by a Russian leader to the disputed islands since they were seized by the Soviet Union in 1945.
stories.event_title: Putin Observes Naval Drills Before Controversial Visit to Disputed Kuril Islands

story_report.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin observed Pacific Fleet naval exercises off Sakhalin Island before visiting Iturup, one of the Russian-controlled Kuril Islands claimed by Japan. Japan called the visit “unacceptable,” with Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi lodging a strong protest and summoning Russia’s ambassador. The trip was Putin’s first visit to the islands, not the first by a Russian leader: former President Dmitry Medvedev visited in 2010. The dispute remains a central obstacle to a formal Japan-Russia peace treaty ending World War II hostilities.

stories.title: Rescue Operation Saves Woman Trapped for 36 Hours After Colombia Earthquake
stories.summary: Emergency workers in Colombia successfully rescued a 32-year-old woman who had been trapped for 36 hours under the rubble of a collapsed building following a powerful earthquake. The rescue operation took 10 hours after the woman was located beneath concrete debris in Pereira, as crews continue to search for additional survivors from the country's strongest earthquake in a century.
stories.event_title: Rescue Teams Save Woman After 36 Hours Trapped in Colombia Earthquake Rubble

story_report.summary: Rescuers in Pereira pulled a 32-year-old woman alive from earthquake rubble after she had been trapped for 36 hours, completing the operation 10 hours after locating her. The rescue offered a rare survival case as Colombia’s emergency response continued after the August 10 quake, which authorities described as the country’s strongest recorded this century. President Abelardo de la Espriella said on August 12 that at least 265 people had died, nearly 500 were missing and more than 25,800 families had been affected.

stories.title: Millions Experience Total Solar Eclipse Across Europe
stories.summary: On Wednesday, millions gathered across Europe to witness a total solar eclipse, the first of its kind in nearly 30 years. The eclipse's path of totality passed through parts of Greenland, Iceland, and northern Spain, creating a moment of awe as the moon completely obscured the sun. Many other regions, including the UK and France, experienced a partial eclipse, with over 90% of the sun covered in some areas.
stories.event_title: Millions Experience Total Solar Eclipse Across Europe

story_report.summary: Millions of people gathered across Europe to watch a total solar eclipse, the first visible on the continent in nearly 30 years. Totality crossed Greenland, Iceland and northern Spain, while much of Europe saw a partial eclipse. Large crowds, particularly in Spain, brought added travel demand and prompted authorities to prepare security, mobility and civil-protection measures for an exceptional concentration of visitors.

stories.title: Congo's Ebola Outbreak Could Become Deadliest in History, WHO Warns

WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus indicated that if the current trend continues, this outbreak could surpass the deadliest Ebola outbreak recorded during the West African epidemic from 2014 to 2016.

story_report.summary: The Ebola outbreak declared in Congo on May 15 has become the second-largest recorded Ebola epidemic, with the World Health Organization reporting 4,449 confirmed cases and 2,061 deaths as of Aug. 12. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the outbreak could overtake the 2014–16 West Africa epidemic if it continues at its current pace. The prospect has intensified pressure on health authorities to improve detection, isolation and care in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.
